# AD5X IFS Spoolman v0.6.10-beta

Repair release for native Fluidd version detection.

## Root cause
The native Fluidd installer treated `/root/fluidd/.version` as the only source of the installed Fluidd version. On the affected AD5X, the current Fluidd tree exists but `.version` and the native marker are missing, so native repair aborted before compatibility assets were even fetched.

## Fixed
- resolve installed Fluidd version from `release_info.json` first;
- fall back to `.version` for compatibility with existing installs;
- fall back again to Moonraker `/machine/update/status` and `version_info.fluidd.version`;
- validate that `release_info.json` identifies `ghzserg/fluidd`;
- fail closed only if all three version sources are unavailable;
- keep the repaired Z-Mod git transport from v0.6.9.

## Compatibility
- Sergey Fluidd compatibility target: `v1.37.6`
- Native IFS UI patch revision: `10`

This repair is specifically intended to recover installations where Fluidd is present but its hidden `.version` file has disappeared.
